main_text.p: Contra tamen facit, quod mulierum ad Scholas nostras admissio (si res caute & provide trutinetur) periculo nostro non vacet: Nam primo quidem sic statuo, acre & excultum artibus ingenium à publicis muniis repelli non debere; Si maligne obsistas, faciet sibi mille dolis & turbis aditum: Igitur si ad Scholas; & ad publica munia admittendae sunt feminae: Quid si nos collegas non ferant? quid si vices, ut meremur, rependant? Abigant nos ad culinam, ad ollas, ad scopas, ad colum, ad infantium pannos & fascias? Solae interim ipsae de summa Reip. consulant, solae arma tractent, solae in templis antistites, in foris judices, in Scholarum suggestibus magistrae: Nec juvat hic toros suos excutere & vi-

page.notes: The scan shows show-through text from the facing page at the right edge, which is not transcribed. The signature mark near the foot of the text block ("K 3") is faint and is not transcribed. Catchword "vi-" is part of the text line, not a separate catchword. Possible doubtful readings: "Solae" and "lateral" words in the last lines are clear; "Scholas" printed as "Scholas" with no hyphen.
